operations.specification: Create a new system configuration entry in discussionboard_configurations. This operation allows authorized administrators to add a new platform-wide configuration parameter for the discussion board application, such as toggling maintenance mode, configuring global limits, or changing policy strings. The payload specifies the atomic config_key, config_value (as string), value_type (such as boolean/int/string/datetime), and optional description. Creation and update timestamps are managed automatically. All configuration parameters must be unique by config_key and are strictly enforced at the database level. This endpoint is essential for DevOps and admin panel integration to handle runtime and policy settings. Only platform administrators are authorized to perform this operation.
operations.description: This operation creates a new system configuration entry in discussionboard_configurations. The body must include config_key (string), config_value (string), value_type (string, like 'boolean'/'int'/'string'/'datetime'), and an optional description. Upon creation, system-managed timestamps are recorded. Only admins may invoke this endpoint. Attempts to duplicate config_key will result in an error; config keys are unique and required for mapping application configuration at runtime. All system, security, and audit logging for configuration events should be consulted in tandem for compliance. Authorization token is required.

operations.specification: Update an existing configuration entry identified by its UUID in discussionboard_configurations. This enables modification of system-wide operational or policy configuration parameters, adhering to platform audit and compliance requirements. Configuration modifications require strict validation: only the config_value, value_type, and description can be updated. The config_key and id are immutable; creation timestamp never changes, but updated_at is set to the time of modification. The endpoint enforces unique constraints and proper atomicity of configuration parameters. Only platform administrators have modify permission. Use for admin UI configuration change features and runtime system tuning.
operations.description: This operation updates an existing configuration in discussionboard_configurations by UUID. Accepts input for config_value, value_type, and description; config_key and id are immutable and cannot be changed. Authorization is required and only admins are permitted access. Unique constraints are validated on the config_key, and all updates record updated_at timestamp for compliance.

Used in admin UIs and DevOps workflows when a configuration becomes obsolete or policy changes.
operations.description: This endpoint marks a configuration in discussionboard_configurations as deleted (soft-deletion) using its UUID. If the ID does not exist, a 404 error is returned. All deletions must be logged in the system audit log. Attempts to delete a configuration that is already deleted will have no side effect beyond idempotent compliance logging.

All returned data is read-only and for review/reporting purposes—no sensitive information is redacted for authorized roles. Authorization: admin only.
operations.description: Returns a paginated, filtered list of audit log entries from discussionboard_audit_logs. Accepts advanced search criteria including actor_id, action_type, action_scope, target_id, and time range. Useful for compliance and post-incident analysis. Result includes metadata required for pagination and auditing. Access limited to admins; audit logs are read-only and retained permanently for regulatory compliance.

All associated business object references are provided for context—real entity records may need to be queried separately. Authorization restricted to admins and platform compliance auditors.

Can be invoked by system internal code or admin panel for compliance/investigation. Input includes action_type, action_scope, actor_id (optional), target_id (optional), and metadata (optional). Automatic recording of creation timestamp is enforced. All insertions are permanently retained for legal and audit purposes. operations.specification: Creates a new like for a specific comment by a member. This operation writes a record to the 'discussionboard_comment_likes' table, which ensures that each member can like a specific comment only once. It is atomic and normalized; duplicate likes are prevented through a unique constraint. The operation requires the comment ID and the member ID. Relevant for engagement metrics and user interaction controls, supporting likes for both UI display and backend analytics.
operations.description: This API allows a member to like a specific comment. Each like action creates a single record in the 'discussionboard_comment_likes' table, ensuring strict normalization - no aggregate likes are calculated here, only atomic like events. Business rules constrain each member to one like per comment; the API enforces this at the DB level, and attempts to like the same comment again result in a constraint violation. Permission checks must ensure only authenticated members may like comments. Like entries are important for both abuse detection and incremental reputation calculation for comments. The operation also supports audit logging, and the timestamp provided is used for analytics. If a comment or member is deleted, all likes cascade as per referential integrity. This is only for 'like' and not for undoing/withdrawing a like, which would require deletion.
operations.summary: Create a like for a comment (discussionboard_comment_likes table).

requestBody.description: Body containing the comment ID and member ID for the like action.

responseBody.description: The created comment like record.

operations.specification: Updates an existing comment like record. This endpoint allows updating the metadata or timestamp associated with a comment like, stored in the 'discussionboard_comment_likes' table, given its primary key ID. Typically, updates are rare for like records, but can occur for audit or restoration actions. This is mainly for system or moderator use rather than regular users.
operations.description: This API allows permissible updates to the comment like record, such as fixing metadata or correcting system-assigned properties. Normal business logic usually does not require updating 'like' actions, but when allowed (e.g., restoring a like after an error or updating the like timestamp for compliance), this API operates on the 'discussionboard_comment_likes' table's primary key (like ID). The API enforces proper audit logging and permission checks; only system, admin, or moderator accounts should generally have this access. This endpoint does not permit changing the association (comment/member), only metadata like timestamps or audit tags. Attempts to mutate the unique like relationship will be rejected by business rules.
operations.summary: Update an existing comment like record by ID (discussionboard_comment_likes table).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the comment like record to update.

requestBody.description: Body containing fields allowed for update (e.g., updated_at timestamp).

responseBody.description: The updated comment like record.

operations.specification: Deletes a comment like record given its unique ID. This removes the association between a member and a liked comment, effectively undoing the like action. The operation targets the 'discussionboard_comment_likes' table and supports members withdrawing their like or moderators removing likes for policy reasons.
operations.description: This API removes a specific comment like by its ID, deleting the row from the 'discussionboard_comment_likes' table. Members can use this endpoint to 'unlike' a comment they've previously liked, while moderators or admins may use it for moderation or audit correction. The endpoint enforces permission and ownership checks: members can only delete their own likes unless they have moderator/admin privileges. The operation irrevocably deletes the record; cascades are handled by referential integrity rules. All deletions are logged for audit/compliance purposes. Attempts to delete a non-existent record result in a not-found error.
operations.summary: Delete a comment like by ID (unlike a comment).

The operation enforces permission checks for non-public data access. Example scenario: Auditing most-disliked comments or inspecting activity by certain members.

Thread creation is also subject to board-level configuration—only active boards may accept new threads. The system will reject requests that attempt to create threads on deactivated or locked boards. Authorization checks ensure the member owns the action and is neither suspended nor banned by moderation policy. Creation records the time, locks/pinned flags, and sets the initial thread status ('active' by default).

The API returns the full thread record, including all assigned metadata, reference IDs for board/creator, and state flags (pinned, locked, etc.) for further business workflows or display. If input values are invalid, or the user is unauthorized, relevant error codes (403, 422, 409) are returned. Integration with audit logs ensures traceability and regulatory compliance. IPageIDiscussionboardSection.ISummary.description: Paginated section summaries with result set and pagination information.

IDiscussionboardSection.description: Full details of discussion board section entity. Maps to Prisma discussionboard_sections.

IDiscussionboardSection.ICreate.description: Payload for creating a new section. Used by POST /discussionboard/sections.

IDiscussionboardSection.IUpdate.description: Update fields for a board section. Supports partial update by PUT /discussionboard/sections/{id}.

IDiscussionboardSection.ISummary.description: Summary view (abridged) of board section entity for paginated lists.

IDiscussionboardConfiguration.IRequest.description: Request structure for searching/paging list of system configuration records. Used in PATCH /discussionboard/configurations referencing discussionboard_configurations table.

IPageIDiscussionboardConfiguration.ISumm.description: Paginated summary results for system configurations. Used in PATCH/response for listing configurations.

IDiscussionboardConfiguration.ISummary.description: Summary information for a configuration entry, as used in paginated responses.

IPage.IPagination.description: Pagination metadata infomation, used in paged result sets.

IDiscussionboardConfiguration.description: A platform configuration entry (as in discussionboard_configurations). Tracks granular, atomic settings that affect global or system-scoped platform behavior. Includes all required fields for config audit, runtime controls, and DevOps. Maps directly to the configuration model in the DB and is referenced in both the admin UI and compliance audit trails.

IDiscussionboardConfigurations.ICreate.description: Payload for creating a new configuration in the discussionboard_configurations table. All required fields must be present and valid per normalization policy. Used by admin configuration panels and DevOps tools.

IDiscussionboardConfigurations.description: Full config row for discussionboard_configurations table; mirrors all columns and serves as the canonical interface for system-wide settings.

IDiscussionboardConfigurations.IUpdate.description: Fields allowed for updating a configuration row in discussionboard_configurations. Only value, type, and description can be changed; key/id/creation dates are immutable.

void.description: Represents an empty response (200/204 No Content). Used for operations that return no data by design.

IDiscussionboardAuditLogs.IRequest.description: Request/filter type for paginated audit log retrieval. Allows precise compliance/audit filtering with optional field selection and strict pagination limits.

IPageIDiscussionboardAuditLogs.description: Paginated/structured response for audit log search/list APIs. See IPage<T> documentation for format, and IDiscussionboardAuditLogs for entry schema.

IDiscussionboardAuditLogs.description: Normalized record of an audit/compliance event in discussionboard_audit_logs, with referential links to actors/resources and JSON-serialized metadata for compliance review.

IDiscussionboardAuditLogs.ICreate.description: Create payload for logging a new audit event in discussionboard_audit_logs. Requires strict mapping to the DB and alignment with platform's audit/compliance policies.

IDiscussionboardAuditLogs.IUpdate.description: Update/patch fields for an audit log entry (cannot modify action_type, action_scope, or created_at; only mutable fields listed here may be updated). Flexible for compliance data corrections.

IDiscussionboardSettings.IRequest.description: Filter and paging criteria to query settings entries in discussionboard_settings. Enables advanced admin/audit or section/member-specific lookup per requirements.

IPageIDiscussionboardSettings.description: Paginated listing structure for settings entries as in list/search APIs. Includes both page/metadata and current page's actual data.

IDiscussionboardSettings.description: A settings entry from discussionboard_settings model, containing governance, UI behavior override, default options, or personalized parameters at global, section, or member scope.

IPage.IPagination.description: Standard page/block metadata for paginated resource API results.

IDiscussionboardThreadFollow.IRequest.description:
Request schema for listing or searching thread follows in the discussion board.

All properties are optional to allow flexible filtering. Pagination parameters conform to standard patterns. This model is referenced from the requirements for follows, notification delivery, and audit review.

Each property aligns with a corresponding filter field in the Prisma model discussionboard_thread_follows.

IPageDiscussionboardThreadFollow.description:
Paginated container for thread follows.

Supplies both pagination info (current page, total records, etc.) and the list of thread follow records found for the given search parameters. Data type is aligned with normalized representation in database and REST API responses. All lists/paging APIs on the discussion board platform return this kind of generic wrapper.

IDiscussionboardThreadFollow.description:
A direct representation of a single member's follow of a thread in the system.

Each property comes directly from the discussionboard_thread_follows Prisma table. Follows enable notification delivery, member engagement analytics, and personalization. Follows are soft-deleted to preserve audit trail, as required by data retention and compliance policy. Used in UIs, notification systems, and profile displays.

IDiscussionboardThreadFollow.ICreate.description:
API contract type for creating a thread follow.

Directly used when a member opts to follow a thread for notifications. Properties match the atomic fields from discussionboard_thread_follows.

IDiscussionboardThreadFollow.IUpdate.description: API contract type for updating thread follow state (soft delete for unfollow, or restoring a previously deleted follow). Only the deleted_at timestamp is editable.

null.description: Represents no response body (HTTP 204 or similar), for operations that intentionally return nothing. Used for delete endpoints or no-content responses.

IDiscussionboardPost.IRequest.description:
Request structure for post listing/search.

Used for PATCH endpoints retrieving lists of posts with complex filters and pagination. Each property matches an indexable/searchable field in the discussionboard_posts Prisma table, following board requirements for search, moderation, compliance, and audit.

IPageDiscussionboardPost.description:
Paginated wrapper for lists of discussion posts.

Contains both the page metadata (needed for navigation/UI) and the main array of posts being bulk-listed.

IDiscussionboardPost.description:
Core normalized post entity from the discussionboard_posts schema.

Contains all atomic fields that represent a member's post within a thread. Each property directly represents a column in the table, referenced in audit, moderation, compliance, and API contracts.

IDiscussionboardPost.ICreate.description:
Request shape for composing/creating a discussion post.

Used by POST endpoints (board posting) to create a new post, enforcing all Prisma schema requirements. Each property directly correlates to the normalized post database record for creation.

IDiscussionboardPost.IUpdate.description: Update contract for posts, permitting modification of title/body, state transitions and soft delete/restore, but not changing post/thread/author.

IDiscussionboardPostEditHistory.IRequest.description: Search/filter contract for listing post edit histories. Used in audit UIs or change review screens.

IPage.IPagination.description:
Pagination metadata for paginated list/result responses.

Fully aligned with standard usage in IPage<T> containers. Enables result navigation and client-side pagination controls.

IDiscussionboardSettings.description:
Global, section 또는 member 단위 설정 레코드를 표현합니다.

platform-wide behavior, UI 테마, 1인의 notification 설정 등 다양한 환경값을 담당하며, 모든 설정은 키-값 조직 및 범위 타입(owner_type)로 구분됩니다.

IDiscussionboardSettings.ICreate.description:
새 settings 항목을 생성할 때 사용하는 요청용 타입.

범위(sction, member, global)와 value, 설명 등을 지정하여 DB에 정상적으로 추가하고자 할 때 사용됩니다.

IDiscussionboardSettings.IUpdate.description:
기존 settings 레코드의 일부를 갱신할 때 쓰는 요청 타입.

값, 설명, owner 속성 등만 변경 가능하며 설정키(setting_key)는 immutable 입니다.

IDiscussionboardMember.IRequest.description: 멤버(DB discussionboard_members) 리스트 검색/조건 조회 시 사용하는 요청 대상. 페이징이나 키워드, 상태 등 검색조건을 동시에 포함할 수 있다.

IPageIDiscussionboardMember.description:
member(회원) 리스트/셀렉션 형태의 페이지 결과 컨테이너.

pagination과 data(list of member summary)로 구성되어 있음.

IDiscussionboardMember.description:
플랫폼 discussionboard_members 테이블의 단일 회원 엔티티.

이메일/닉네임/생성일자/갱신일자 등 정보를 포함하며, 소프트 딜리트 상태를 표현할 수 있다.

IDiscussionboardMember.ICreate.description:
멤버 신규가입 요청 body type. 이메일, 닉네임, 원문 비밀번호 필수.

성공적 요청 시 DB 내 hash 변환/중복체크가 서버단에서 실행됨.

IDiscussionboardMember.IUpdate.description:
멤버(회원) 정보 갱신 요청 type. nick/email/pw 중 하나 이상 수정 가능.

삭제시에는 deleted_at에 시각을 입력하며, 필드 명확화 위해 null 지원.

IDiscussionboardModerator.IRequest.description:
discussionboard_moderators DB 테이블에서 할당자/수임자/활성상태 기준으로 필터링하거나 검색할 때 사용.

페이징/필터 조합 가능.

IPageIDiscussionboardModerator.description: Moderators(중재자 할당/배정)의 목록형 page 컨테이너. pagination + data 구성.

IDiscussionboardModerator.description: discussionboard_moderators 한 건의 할당(=중재자 1인 기록). 권한/상태변화 모두 기록, PK 기반.

IDiscussionboardModerator.ICreate.description: 새 Moderator 권한 부여(create) 요청 구조. 반드시 멤버+관리자 UUID 지정 필요.

IPage.IPagination.description:
페이징 지원형 결과의 공통 정보 구조.

전체 검색 결과에서 현재 조회된 페이지만 가져올 때, 페이징 위치와 전체 레코드 개수를 함께 제공합니다.

IDiscussionboardSearchHistory.IDeleteRes.description:
Delete response for a discussion board search history event. This type signals the result of a user- or admin-initiated deletion from the search history table.

Implements response conventions for user right-to-erase, retention audit, and compliance per non-functional requirements. Includes status and optional context for API or UI logic.

IDiscussionboardPolicy.IRequest.description:
Request/search criteria for listing policies in the discussion board. This type is used as the request body for paginated, filterable search of board policies, as described in the policy center and compliance UI.

Includes filter fields to cover requirements around transparency, versioned audit of platform rules, and effective/expiry window controls. Aligns with search/list requirements in functional and non-functional documentation.

IPageIDiscussionboardPolicy.description:
Paginated response type for a list of policy records. Implements the IPage<T> contract for collections, supporting board-wide policy management and audit UIs as required in documentation.

The pagination object tracks paging state, total records, and window configuration. Data provides the array of retrieved policy objects for the window. Used globally for all paginated policy endpoints.

IDiscussionboardPolicy.description:
Represents a single discussion board policy record. Captures the complete programmatic representation for platform policy as defined in the policy domain. Includes all version, lifecycle, and audit metadata.

Implements business rules for displaying, auditing, and spanning the lifecycle of community and platform policies. All fields reference the Prisma schema discussionboard_policies model with detailed field-level guidance.

IDiscussionboardPolicy.ICreate.description:
Request body for creating a new discussion board policy. Includes all business and audit-necessary fields to define and establish a new policy document in the platform.

All properties map directly to regulatory, compliance, and UI/UX requirements as established in platform documentation and Prisma schema.

IDiscussionboardPolicy.IUpdate.description:
Request body for updating the entire record of a policy document. Enables admins to revise policy content, schedule changes, or correct metadata for compliance.

Aligns with audit/mutation business logic for board policy and regulatory compliance. All properties support traceable updates as required by platform and legal requirements.

IDiscussionboardPolicy.IDeleteResponse.description: Response type for a policy deletion action. Confirms success or failure and provides an explanatory message for UI, API, or audit trail. Required for policy lifecycle management.

IDiscussionboardPolicyUpdate.IRequest.description:
Request body for searching/listing policy update records, including filtering, sorting, and pagination controls as required by compliance and transparent history requirements.

All properties align with audit log use cases, policy version review, and admin workflows described in platform documentation.

IPageIDiscussionboardPolicyUpdate.description:
Paginated response for a policy update log/event history operation. Implements the generic IPage pattern for audit/compliance tools and UI components.

Business requirement: Surface filtered, sorted, and paged log records for policy change workflow, as in admin dashboards.

IDiscussionboardPolicyUpdate.description:
Represents a single audit event/summary record for a discussion board policy update. Captures the actor, what changed, and when, as required for regulatory, transparency, and UI display purposes.

Links to audit log domain, policy entity, and administrative staff for rollback/notification use.

IDiscussionboardPolicyUpdate.ICreate.description: Request body for creating a new policy update event/audit log record. Required for UI workflow, transparency, and compliance requirements for documenting all policy changes with context, actor, and summary as per documentation.

IDiscussionboardPolicyUpdate.IUpdate.description: Request body for updating the summary or auxiliary info of a policy update event. Used for compliance corrections, audit trail annotations, and rare administrative corrections, as outlined in platform processes.

IPage.IPagination.description: Page information for paged result sets on list/search endpoints across the API. Implements the canonical IPage.IPagination structure per requirements document and type-convention expectations.

IPageIDiscussionboardCommentEditHistory.description:
A paginated list of Comment Edit History records for the discussion board. This schema is used for responses where a collection of comment edit change events—such as all edits to a specific comment or all edits within a time range—need to be presented along with standard pagination information.

This container ensures structured delivery of large result sets. Each entry in 'data' is a full Comment Edit History record. Pagination information is required to support browsing through potentially thousands of edit history events for audit, moderation, or transparency viewing. Refer to IDiscussionboardCommentEditHistory for field-level details.

IDiscussionboardCommentEditHistory.description:
A record of a single edit to a discussion board comment. Captures the editor, the full comment body as it existed during this revision, and the exact time of the edit. Supports comment audit trail, rollback/restore, and edit attribution requirements per compliance/audit policies.

Directly references the source comment and the editing member for auditability. Multiple revisions of a comment (e.g., user makes several tweaks, or moderator redacts content) generate one entry each, preserving the full revision chain for forensic review.

IDiscussionboardCommentEditHistory.ICrea.description: Request body for creating a new comment edit history record. Used whenever a comment is edited for any reason—by the author, moderator, or admin. Contains both the reference to the source comment, the editor's member id, and the revised text body. Does not set the edited_at timestamp, which is system-generated.

IDiscussionboardCommentEditHistory.IUpda.description: Body for updating an existing comment edit history record. For audit/rollback corrections only; normally, edit history records are immutable except for system administrative reasons. Only the 'body' field is updatable.

IDiscussionboardCommentLike.IRequest.description: Request object for searching and filtering comment like records. Supports querying by comment, by member, and within a date/time window. Also defines pagination controls for large result sets. Used by admin/moderator dashboards and analytics endpoints.

IPageIDiscussionboardCommentLike.description: A paginated set of discussion board comment like records. Each page delivery includes pagination metadata and a list of like records matching the user's query. Used to enumerate who liked which comments, perform analytics, or moderate suspicious engagement patterns.

IDiscussionboardCommentLike.description: A single 'like' action by a member on a comment. Used to support engagement analytics, show like counts, and power notification systems. Only one like per (member, comment) tuple is allowed. Record must persist even if comment or member is deactivated (for audit/compliance).

IDiscussionboardCommentLike.ICreate.description: Request body to create a new comment like event. Both comment and member must be valid and active. Only one like per member-comment pair is allowed by business rule and DB constraint.

IDiscussionboardCommentLike.IUpdate.description: Admin-only: allows correcting the creation timestamp for a comment like (for audit or compliance use-cases only). No other fields are updatable.

IDiscussionboardCommentDislike.IRequest.description: Request filter object for searching and paging comment dislikes. Used for generating dislike analytics, abuse review, or personal feedback workflows.

IPageIDiscussionboardCommentDislike.description: Response structure for a paginated, filterable set of comment dislike actions. Used in analytics dashboards, engagement review, and moderator abuse detection workflows.

IDiscussionboardCommentDislike.description: A single dislike event linking a member and a comment. Used for negative engagement analytics, abuse signal processing, and showing dislike counts in the UI. Dislike is a one-to-one relationship between member and comment; only a single active dislike permitted per pair by business rule.

IPage.IPagination.description: Pagination information for a paginated result set. Contains current position and total available records/pages in the set.

IEmptyResponse.description:
A standardized empty response structure for API endpoints that do not provide a body in the response.

This is used across the discussion board API to signal successful operations where no additional data is required, such as successful deletions or actions that do not return meaningful data.

This structure is intentionally empty but enables type-safe OpenAPI documentation and generator compatibility.

ISearchIndex.IRequest.description:
Request structure for filtered, paginated, and sorted listing of search index records for the discussion board platform.

Allows admins, moderators, or search UIs to specify entity type filters, time ranges, keywords, and sort or paging. Enables advanced search for posts, comments, and other business objects using in-database or external FTS engines.

IPageISearchIndex.description:
A paginated result structure for search index records, including pagination metadata and a list of ISearchIndex objects.

Embeds the IPage.IPagination structure from standard container types and enforces type safety for advanced client-side search, infinite scrolling, or analytics interfaces.

ISearchIndex.description:
A normalized, atomic search index record used for powering platform search, analytics, and discovery features.

Mapped directly from the discussionboard_search_indexes table in the Prisma schema, with every property corresponding to a column or business rule from the requirements documentation.

ISearchIndex.ICreate.description:
Request structure for creating a new search index record for a board entity.

Fields must match normalized schema; backend will assign ID and timestamp. Used for new entity ingest or manual indexing via admin tools.

ISearchIndex.IUpdate.description: Update structure for an existing search index entry. Only mutable fields may be changed. Used for admin corrections, reindex after moderation, or data migration.

ISearchHistory.IRequest.description: Request structure to filter and page through search history records on the politics/economy discussion board.

IPageISearchHistory.description:
Paginated array of member search history records, matching the provided ISearchHistory.IRequest query.

Used for analytics, privacy self-management, and audit review. Embeds standard page info and result set.

ISearchHistory.description:
A normalized search history record, tracking what was searched, by whom (nullable), when, with what filters, and the result count.

Used for self-service review, privacy, analytics, and compliance traceability. Maps to the discussionboard_search_histories entity precisely.

IDiscussionboardSearchHistory.ICreate.description:
Request structure for creating a search history event in discussionboard_search_histories.

Supports analytics, user's privacy rights (GDPR/CCPA), and platform self-service features.

IDiscussionboardSearchHistory.description: Canonical search history entry as recorded in discussionboard_search_histories, used for analytics, self-review, audit, and compliance.

IDiscussionboardSearchHistory.IUpdate.description: Update structure for a search history entry. All fields are optional and only changed as needed for audit/analytics corrections or data migration (admin use only).

IPageIDiscussionboardMemberHistory.description:
Paginated response structure for a list of discussion board member history records.

Complies with service requirements for audit logging and history review, including full pagination metadata and an array of history entries. Used for admin/moderator audit tools and activity review. See also IPage<T> generic component.

IDiscussionboardMemberHistory.description:
Record of a single change to member profile, role, or account, implemented per audit/compliance requirements.

Each event/row links to a member, archives details about the event, and is timestamped for review. See 02_discussionboard_user_roles_and_journeys.md and Actors domain Prisma schema for domain rules.

IDiscussionboardMemberHistory.ICreate.description:
Request body type for creating a new member history audit event.

Comprises the member id, change type, and serialized detail as required for audit trail creation by privileged actions or user events.

IdiscussionboardMemberHistories.IUpdate.description:
Request type for updating a member history audit/event record (for admin uses).

Allows correcting change type and data as per audit or legal review.

IdiscussionboardMemberHistories.description:
Record of a single change to member profile, role, or account, implemented per audit/compliance requirements (alternate variant for legacy endpoint compatibility).

Structure matches IDiscussionboardMemberHistory for ID-based retrieval.

IdiscussionboardBoards.IRequest.description:
Request type for paginated/filtering/search of boards for listing API.

Contains pagination (page/limit), search/filter options as per board list views. All fields optional—default returns earliest N boards.

IPageIdiscussionboardBoards.ISummary.description:
Paginated result page for a listing of discussion boards, with summary records for each.

Pages include metadata and a data array of ISummary type board entries suitable for UI listing, navigation, or quick selection.

IdiscussionboardBoards.description: A single discussion board entity, as used in major groupings of threads. Includes atomic ID, display label, status, and timestamps for audit.

IdiscussionboardBoards.ICreate.description:
Request type for creating a new board entity.

Requires unique name and initial activity/visibility, optional description.

IdiscussionboardBoards.IUpdate.description: Request type for updating a board's label, description, or activation status.

IdiscussionboardBoardTags.IRequest.description: Request for paginated/filtering retrieval of board tag entries. All fields optional.

IPageIdiscussionboardBoardTags.ISummary.description: Paginated result object (board tag list), with summary data as needed for UI.

discussionboard_appeals.ICreate.description:
Creation schema for appeals in the discussion board moderation context. This type models all fields required to submit a new appeal by a member when contesting a moderation action (ban, warning, content removal). Fulfills the requirements of the platform's appeals workflow and records all necessary information for tracking, review, and audit. Aligned to the corresponding Prisma table and requirements documentation for appeal creation.

This detailed schema ensures the appeal contains a clear reference to the moderation action, the type and message of the appeal, and the identity of the appellant. It supports platform transparency, accountability, and compliance for member dispute resolution.

discussionboard_appeals.IUpdate.description:
Update schema for discussion board appeals. This type is used when reviewing or responding to a submitted appeal, supporting update actions by admins (status changes, adding review messages, assignment of reviewer, etc.) or appellant updates prior to resolution. Closely matches the requirements for dispute resolution, appeal lifecycle management, and full moderation workflow compliance.

Proper documentation ensures that each updatable field (such as status, assigned reviewer, or response message) fulfills business needs for appeals tracking, transparency, and regulatory traceability.

discussionboard_notifications.IRequest.description:
Request schema for searching and filtering notification records in the notification system table. This type is used for advanced filtering, sorting, and pagination of member notification records. The schema matches requirements for user notification UIs, admin audit, and compliance review as specified in requirements and Prisma schema documentation.

All fields are optional to enable flexible querying over date range, delivery channel, type, status, and receiver. Pagination controls are implemented for large result sets. Ensures that the query model is extensible for evolving notification feature requirements.

IPageDiscussionboardNotifications.description:
Paginated result container for notification records, implementing platform standard for paged responses in listing/searching. Combines pagination metadata, array of results, and total count for client-side control. Fulfills user experience and business needs for scalable notification retrieval, audit visibility, and compliance reporting.

Model matches requirements for reporting, UI iteration, and consistent API experience across paged objects.

discussionboard_notifications.description:
Entity schema for a notification delivery record in the system, as described by requirements and mapped to the discussionboard_notifications Prisma table. Holds all consistently stored atomic notification data: who received it, what event triggered it, what entity/context, state, and audit-relevant metadata.

Fulfills requirements for platform's notification/on-site/email/push mechanism, audit, engagement tracking, and user experience. Closely aligned to UI display/management needs.

discussionboard_notifications.ICreate.description:
Schema for creating a new notification record in the system. Used by backend events and admins to deliver notifications to members for various platform events. Required fields enforce business logic, audit compliance, and technical delivery features. Closely mirrors the production notification entity, except omitting audit-only fields (ID/timestamps or system-managed).

Fully aligned with requirements for engagement, moderation, and notification transparency.

discussionboard_notifications.IUpdate.description:
Schema for updating an existing notification record. Permits modifications such as marking as read/unread, updating message content, or correcting audit fields. Typically used in audit correction, admin clean-up, or UX-driven bulk state transitions (such as batch marking as read). Complies with platform requirements for transparency and auditability.

Includes only those fields permitted to be updated post-creation (e.g., cannot change id or delivery timestamp).

INotificationPreference.IRequest.description:
Schema for searching/filtering member notification preferences. Enables advanced filtering by notification type, channel, member, and enabled state, supporting admin audit, self-service UX, and analytics use cases as described in requirements document.

All filters optional to allow broad or highly specific queries across notification delivery and engagement preferences.

IPageINotificationPreference.description: Paginated response container for notification preference queries. Fulfills requirements for generic platform page wrappers: contains result array and pagination metadata, enabling compliance with UI, audit, and analytics needs across the notification preferences domain.

INotificationPreference.description:
Entity schema for a notification preference record. Reflects the notification customization a member has set (or system default) for channel, type, and enable/disable state. Aligned to the Prisma table and requirements for notification delivery management and user engagement controls.

The schema enables robust user opt-in/out control over notification types, supporting audit, compliance, and full UI integration. Each field is atomic, versioned, and required for correct usage/traceability.

INotificationPreference.ICreate.description:
Schema for creating a new notification preference. Supports members (or admins) establishing new delivery preferences for the first time or initializing on onboarding, as required by requirements documentation.

Enforces unique combinations per (member,type,channel), audit policy, and must align with notification delivery/opt-out requirements. Each field is required to properly scope the new preference and ensure correct system behavior.

INotificationPreference.IUpdate.description:
Schema for updating a notification preference record. Allows authorized parties (the member or admin) to modify notification delivery types, channels, or enabled state as their preferences or compliance needs change. Fulfills all functional, privacy, and audit trace requirements as per requirements and platform standard for opt-in/out.

All fields optional for PATCH, but must be supplied for complete PUT; this schema is the basis for preference edit flows both in admin panels and self-service UX.

IPage.IPagination.description:
Standard pagination information for paged API responses in the discussion board platform. Implements all requirements for consistent paged UX, audit, and scalable result enumeration. Used in nearly all paged result sets systemwide.

Includes current page, limit per page, total records, and page count as required for comprehensive UI and API operation.

Idiscussionboard_postDislikes.ICreate.description:
Request body structure for creating a new post dislike. Maps to the business case of a user expressing a negative reaction on a post, with strict normalization of each dislike event. Properties match schema columns in discussionboard_post_dislikes. Ensures 1:1 mapping with post and acting member for proper analytics and abuse prevention.

Corresponds with Idiscussionboard_postDislikes.ICreate in the OpenAPI specification.

Idiscussionboard_postDislikes.IUpdate.description: Update payload for an existing post dislike (discussionboard_post_dislikes table). Used by privileged roles (admin/moderator) for audit correction of historical dislike records. Typically only the timestamp is mutable; post_id and member_id are immutable in production as per platform policy.

Idiscussionboard_postReports.IRequest.description:
Request body for listing, searching, or filtering post report records in the moderation and content policy workflow. Supports pagination, searching by reporter, post, code, date/time windows, and resolved status. All properties correspond to columns in the discussionboard_post_reports schema.

Intended for moderation UI, audit dashboards, and member report review features.

IPageIdiscussionboard_postReports.description:
Paginated result for listing post reports in discussionboard_post_reports. Used by admin/moderator dashboards for moderation queue, history display, and analytics.

Follows standard IPage<T> container with fields for pagination and a record list. Data property uses the lightweight ISummary type for efficient aggregation.

Idiscussionboard_postReports.description:
Atomic report event entity for a discussion board post, mapping precisely to the discussionboard_post_reports schema.

Includes all normalized data: reporter, post association, reason codes, timestamps, and optional free-text rationale. Used for audit, moderation, and analytics. Aligns 1:1 with the database structure and retention policy.

Idiscussionboard_postReports.ICreate.description:
Payload structure for creating a new post report/flag record under the post moderation workflow.

Strictly normalized and maps directly to column fields in discussionboard_post_reports relevant for content abuse/report handling and analytics.

IDiscussionboardPostReport.IUpdate.description:
Update structure for post report records, allowing patches to reason, moderator notes, or resolution status. Used by moderation/admin actions to close/annotate report entries and maintain full audit trace.

Only permitted fields are present in this schema.

IDiscussionboardPostReport.description: Response schema for a single atomic post report entity, returned when fetching or creating post report records. 1:1 mapping with normalized columns in the discussionboard_post_reports table, including all relational references and moderation workflow fields.

IDiscussionboardPostAttachment.IRequest.description:
Request body structure for searching, filtering, and paginating results in the post attachment listing API. Maps directly to the business use case of reviewing, auditing, or discovering assets attached to content, per functional requirements and admin dashboard needs. Satisfies 3NF normalization for search and analytics.

All fields correspond to columns in the discussionboard_post_attachments table.

IPageIDiscussionboardPostAttachment.description: Paginated, searchable response for post attachment list queries on discussion board posts. Follows IPage<T> convention with page metadata and an array of summary entity objects for efficient list rendering in admin/member UI. The ISummary object type is lighter-weight than the full attachment entity, for scalable transfer/overview.

IDiscussionboardPostAttachment.description: Full normalized entity for a post attachment on a discussion board post. 1:1 mapping with columns in discussionboard_post_attachments, with no BLOB or binary fields—URIs/metadata only.

IDiscussionboardPostAttachment.ICreate.description: Request body structure for creating a new post attachment record. Does not include upload of the binary asset, only the reference URI, file metadata, and association to the post. Maps normalized columns in discussionboard_post_attachments table.

IPage.IPagination.description: Standard pagination metadata for a paged list response. Part of IPage<T> pattern.

Idiscussionboard_postReports.ISummary.description: Summary version of the post report entity for lightweight list rendering. Contains only essential fields for moderation dashboards or analytics overviews. 1:1 with discussionboard_post_reports.ISummary in OpenAPI spec.

IDiscussionboardPostAttachment.ISummary.description: Summary structure for a post attachment as used in list/grid views, lighter than full entity.

IDiscussionboardCommunityGuidelines.IReq.description: Request object for listing, searching, or filtering Community Guidelines. Matches business requirements for transparency, audit, versioning, and multilingual access. Designed for the PATCH /discussionboard/communityGuidelines endpoint as described in the OpenAPI operation and Prisma schema. Allows admins, moderators, and members to query historical, draft, or currently effective Community Guidelines using flexible search criteria. Supports pagination and sorting, aiding both UI and compliance tools.

IPageIDiscussionboardCommunityGuidelines.description: Paginated result structure for Community Guidelines listing/searching. Conforms to IPage<T> interface as described in the system OpenAPI specification. Includes a pagination object and an array of guideline summary/detail entities (full IDiscussionboardCommunityGuidelines type). Used in PATCH /discussionboard/communityGuidelines responses and aligned with list/search business requirements.

IDiscussionboardCommunityGuidelines.description: Main schema for a single Community Guideline record. Fulfills requirements for versioned, effective-dated, fully-auditable policy records for the discussion board platform. Contains all atomic guideline fields specified in the Prisma schema, including version, effective/expiry dates, and actor attribution. Used in all guideline CRUD operations (get, create, update, delete) and rendered in administrative/policy user interfaces.

IDiscussionboardCommunityGuidelines.ICre.description: Request body for the creation of a new Community Guideline. Contains all required fields as defined by the business rules: title, body, version, creation actor, and optional effective/expired dates for phased or future rollout. Structured for use by administrative UI, compliance automation, and onboarding tooling. Fields and documentation directly derived from the Prisma schema and requirements documentation.

IDiscussionboardCommunityGuidelines.IUpd.description: Update body for existing Community Guideline records. Permits revision of specified properties: title, body, version, effective/expired dates. Used by admins/moderators for correction, scheduled rollout, or withdrawal of guidelines. Designed in line with the business versioning and compliance requirements, enabling transparent and auditable changes to the guidelines catalog.

IPage.IPagination.description: Pagination metadata container for any IPage<T> result, as required by the API specification for paging large query sets. Used across all entity list/search endpoints. Each property derives directly from the IPage standard and satisfies client-side integrity rules for navigation in paginated collections.

IDiscussionboardCommentDislike.ICreate.description:
Payload schema for creating a dislike action on a comment. This type is used when a member wishes to register a negative reaction to a specific comment, and must include both the target comment and the acting member.

Maps directly to the creation of a row in 'discussionboard_comment_dislikes'. Ensures normalization, referential integrity and audit compliance.

IDiscussionboardCommentDislike.IUpdate.description:
Update schema for modifying a comment dislike record. This is typically only used by admin or moderator roles for audit correction or compliance purposes. Contains only fields that are allowed to change per policy.

Directly references only modifiable attributes from 'discussionboard_comment_dislikes'.

IDiscussionboardCommentReport.IRequest.description:
Query/request object for listing, searching, and filtering comment reports for moderation, analytics, or compliance review. Every property is optional and used to filter results from the discussionboard_comment_reports table.

Used by admin/moderator UI and member-facing report history.

IDiscussionboardCommentReport.description:
The canonical, persisted representation of a comment report record in the moderation/audit workflow. Used in all detail, review, and response flows for abuse reporting on comments.

Fully normalized and audit-traceable, in alignment with the 'discussionboard_comment_reports' table schema.

IDiscussionboardCommentReport.ICreate.description:
Payload for creating a new report (flag) on a comment. Minimum is the target comment, reporting member, and violation reason code; optional details for evidence/context are permitted.

Maps to insertion into 'discussionboard_comment_reports'.

IDiscussionboardCommentReport.IUpdate.description: Payload for updating a comment report record (correction, audit, or clarification). Not all properties are required - only changed fields are typically provided. Used by admin/moderator for compliance/audit, or by system logic when updating evidence/context.

IPageIDiscussionboardCommentReport.description: A paginated result set for comment report records. Fulfills audit/compliance requirements for scalable review of abuse reports. Standardized page structure aids in consistent API documentation and backend/frontend integration.

IDiscussionboardReport.IRequest.description: Request body schema for searching, filtering, and paginating reports from the moderation workflow table 'discussionboard_reports'. Properties are all optional; each narrows the search results by the specified dimension.

IPageIDiscussionboardReport.ISummary.description: Paginated, filterable summary results for report (flag) entities in the moderation workflow. Used by moderators and admins for compliance, auditing, and reporting dashboards. Standardized page shape for all list/paging endpoints.

IDiscussionboardReport.description: Canonical, fully-persisted business object for a flagging/report event in the moderation system. Encapsulates all atomic violation data, reporter, target entity, categorization, and audit trail as required in the 'discussionboard_reports' schema table.

IDiscussionboardReport.ICreate.description: Creation request schema for filing a new report (flag) against a post or comment in the moderation system. Must provide the actor (member), reason, target entity (post, comment, or both), and the anonymity flag. Evidence/details are optional but recommended for clarity.

IDiscussionboardReport.IUpdate.description:
Update schema for modifying a persisted report (flag) in the moderation system. Used for editing the violation category, adding/correcting evidence, or reassigning target reference after audit or escalation workflows. Not all properties must be specified in an update; typically only those being changed are included.

This type is only for privileged system roles or audit system corrections.

IPage.IPagination.description: Pagination metadata for any paginated response (including search/list APIs, admin panes, and most filterable endpoints). Defines the contract for paging state across all standard IPage<T> structures. Used consistently across the board for UI/UX and API navigation.

IDiscussionboardModerator.IUpdate.description:
This type defines the structure for updating moderator assignments within the actors domain of the political/economic discussion board platform. It is based on the discussionboard_moderators table and is typically used to revoke or manage moderator privileges for a member.

The only updatable field is `revoked_at`, a timestamp indicating when (if at all) moderator privileges were revoked. This is used for admin workflows and compliance audit trails.

Reference: Prisma schema discussionboard_moderators and the requirements on moderator role lifecycles.

IDiscussionboardAdmin.IRequest.description: Request/criteria type for listing/searching discussion board administrator accounts. Implements admin panel, audit, and compliance listing/search workflows. Reference: discussionboard_admins table in Prisma.

IPageIDiscussionboardAdmin.description:
Paginated result container type for returning admin (system administrator) query results. Standard pagination contract.

- pagination: metadata per current page, total results, total pages, etc.
- data: array of admin records matching search/filter.

IDiscussionboardAdmin.description:
Admin account/entity type for platform administrators. Reference: discussionboard_admins table in actors domain.

Properties include primary key, email, username, and audit timestamps.

IDiscussionboardAdmin.ICreate.description:
Input type for creating a new administrator on the discussion board platform. Captures email, username, and password as necessary for account creation and initial onboarding.

Reference: discussionboard_admins table.

IDiscussionboardAdmin.IUpdate.description:
Type for updating mutable admin account fields. Fields are all optional and may be updated individually: email, username, or password.

Reference: discussionboard_admins in actors domain.

IDiscussionboardMemberProfile.IRequest.description:
Request/filter type for listing or searching member profiles in the actors domain.

Includes support for filtering by display name, bio, locale, timezone, and creation time window.

Reference: discussionboard_member_profiles table in the Prisma schema.

IPageIDiscussionboardMemberProfile.description:
Standard paginated result type for arrays of member profiles.

- pagination: page meta information
- data: profile records array

Reference: requirements for API paginated search and the discussionboard_member_profiles table.

IDiscussionboardMemberProfile.description:
Canonical type for member profile entities in the actors domain of the political/economic board. Properties represent normalized profile info attached to a member.

Reference: discussionboard_member_profiles.

IDiscussionboardMemberProfile.ICreate.description:
Type for creating a new member profile for a board user. Includes member FK, optional display name, bio, avatar, locale, timezone.

Reference: discussionboard_member_profiles schema.

IDiscussionboardMemberProfile.IUpdate.description:
Type for updating one or more editable member profile fields. All properties are optional/nullable (see schema for details).

Reference: discussionboard_member_profiles.

IDiscussionboardMemberHistory.IRequest.description:
Filter/search type for querying member history event log entries (audit/change logs).

Reference: discussionboard_member_histories table.

IPage.IPagination.description:
Pagination metadata structure. Used in all paginated result types.

current: current page
limit: per-page max
records: total found
pages: total pages

IDiscussionboardBoardFeature.ICreate.description:
Creation schema for assigning a new board feature flag. Contains atomic feature assignment details per business, audit, and board management requirements.

Aligns with the 'discussionboard_board_features' Prisma model and board configuration use cases. All properties are required and thoroughly validated. Refer to the Prisma table and requirements for further details.

IDiscussionboardBoardFeature.IUpdate.description: Update schema for modifying a board feature assignment. Reference: 'discussionboard_board_features' Prisma table and requirements document. Feature key and enabled state are required as per business logic.

IDiscussionboardThread.IRequest.description: Request structure for searching, filtering, and paginating threads. All properties are optional except for possible business rules requiring at least one filter. Reference the full Prisma model, board organization, and requirements doc for more.

IPageDiscussionboardThread.description:
Paginated result container for discussion board threads.

This type models the platform-wide result structure for thread searches/listings, conforming to the IPage<T> interface described in standard business requirements.

Property details:
- pagination: See IPage.IPagination for structure, which includes page index, record totals, etc.
- data: Array of thread summaries (not full detail) as suitable for listings/UIs.

References the requirements 'standard container types' and examples in documentation.

IDiscussionboardThread.description:
Main entity schema for a discussion board thread. Implements requirements on threading and platform conversation lifecycle as per the ERD and requirements documents.

Contains all atomic and normalized thread fields per database, audit, and moderation requirements. Refer to the Prisma model for additional context. All properties' descriptions reflect their corresponding schema columns and business policies.

IDiscussionboardThread.ICreate.description: Request body schema for new thread creation. Validates all inputs per business, audit, and security requirements as listed in the platform's ERD and requirements documentation. Carefully integrate status, display, and moderation inputs for complete coverage.

IDiscussionboardThread.IUpdate.description: Update payload for an existing thread. Accepts all mutable properties in the discussionboard_threads model, enforcing rules as per audit/compliance and business logic documents. All updates are recorded for history as per platform requirements.

IDiscussionboardThread.ISummary.description:
Summary schema for listing threads in paginated results. Contains the minimal set of properties for list and search UI, as required in IPageDiscussionboardThread.data.

Built to requirements for listings, analytics, and quick thread access on board pages.

IPage.IPagination.description: Standard page information as per the IPage<T> container. Used for pagination UIs and API responses everywhere that returns page-based lists.

IDiscussionboardThreadSnapshot.IRequest.description: Search and paging request for thread snapshot version records. All properties optional unless business workflow demands at least one search constraint. Used in audit, rollback, and compliance review scenarios. See requirements, audit, and ERD for full context.

IPageDiscussionboardThreadSnapshot.description: Paginated result container for thread snapshot version records. Conforms to IPage<T> platform pattern for audit/compliance browsing, rollback, and change history workflows.

IDiscussionboardThreadSnapshot.description: Main entity schema for thread snapshot version records (audit/version history for thread metadata). Maps strictly to the discussionboard_thread_snapshots table. All fields provide evidence for audit/tracking, with full normalization against the thread's current state.

IDiscussionboardThreadSnapshot.ICreate.description: Creation request for a new thread snapshot. Normalized, audit-compliant version tracking entity per lifecycle, rollback, and moderation requirements. All fields must match thread state precisely for legitimate restoration/audit.

IDiscussionboardThreadSnapshot.IUpdate.description: Update payload for an existing thread snapshot version record. Enables corrections as allowed by audit, compliance, and business policy.

IDiscussionboardThreadSnapshot.ISummary.description: Summary record for thread snapshots—minimal field set for version list UIs, audit trails, and rollback operations.

IDiscussionboardReportHistory.IRequest.description:
Request model to search and filter events in moderation report history as required by audit workflows.

Enables the retrieval of historical event records related to a moderation case (such as status changes, escalations, assignments, or resolutions). Each filter parameter aligns with normalized columns in the moderation history table and platform business logic regarding change/audit trail retention.

IPageIDiscussionboardReportHistory.ISumm.description:
Standardized paginated response for a moderation report history search.

Each entry summarizes an event in the moderation lifecycle as required for audit, compliance, and business process review. Results include both the event timeline and metadata (such as actor, action type, and notes).

IDiscussionboardReportHistory.ISummary.description:
Summary of a moderation report lifecycle event, used in IPage pagination lists and UIs requiring audit timelines.

Reflects the essential audit information for a single moderation workflow event as required for the discussion board's compliance and transparency processes.

IDiscussionboardReportHistory.description:
Full record of a moderation report history entry from the discussionboard_report_histories table.

Captures event metadata, actor, type, details, and precise time, as required for in-depth audit, compliance reporting, and business review after resolution of flagged board content.

IDiscussionboardReportHistory.ICreate.description: Request payload for creating a new moderation report history entry in the audit log as per compliance and workflow requirements.

IDiscussionboardReportHistory.IUpdate.description: Patchable fields for updating a moderation report history record. Used in administrative correction/audit workflows, only fields present will be updated.

IDiscussionboardModerationAction.IReques.description:
Request model to search/filter for moderation actions, as required for audit/review workflows and admin dashboards.

All parameters are optional but enable precise querying for high-volume audit-compliance and operational review scenarios.

IPageIDiscussionboardModerationAction.IS.description: Paginated set of moderation action summary results. Used for UI dashboards, audit reviews, and statistics.

IDiscussionboardModerationAction.ISummar.description: Summary representation of a moderation action, as used in paginated action review UIs, audit lists, and dashboard statistics.

IDiscussionboardModerationAction.description: Full normalized moderation action audit record, referencing the related moderation report, moderator, and targeted post/comment entity as appropriate for complete audit/compliance review and platform governance requirements.

IDiscussionboardModerationAction.ICreate.description: Request payload to create a new moderation action record for audit trace, moderation workflow, and UI statistics displays.

IDiscussionboardModerationAction.IUpdate.description: Patch/update fields for a moderation action record. Used for administrative corrections or audit workflow fixes; only the represented fields will be updated.

IDiscussionboardBan.IRequest.description:
Structured request body for searching/filtering bans on the discussion board system.

Aligns with audit/appeals/compliance flows for reviewing ban history, appeals, and moderation performance.

IPageIDiscussionboardBan.description: Standard page container for lists of ban records, as used by moderation dashboards, appeals workflows, and compliance tools.

IDiscussionboardBan.description: Describes a ban record (temporary/permanent) for a board member as recorded in the system, linked to moderation actions for full traceability and appeals/compliance management.

IPage.IPagination.description: Page meta-information for IPage responses, as defined in platform-standard type.

IdiscussionboardBoardTags.description:
Board-level tag entity as defined in the Prisma schema (discussionboard_board_tags). Represents the atomic assignment of a label to a board for search/discovery. See schema and ERD: Board Tags domain.

Every property is present, normalized, and documented for RBAC, analytics, and admin curation UIs.

References: Prisma discussionboard_board_tags, tag management requirements, and search discovery logic.

IdiscussionboardBoardTags.ICreate.description:
Request type for creating a board tag (discussionboard_board_tags.ICreate). Contains all properties needed to create a tag assignment atomically and according to normalization rules.

References: Prisma model, tag creation business rules, and UI documentation.

IdiscussionboardBoardTags.IUpdate.description: Request type for updating board tag assignments (discussionboard_board_tags.IUpdate). Only the tag value can be updated in this scenario; all other fields are immutable for normalization/audit.

IDiscussionboardBoardCategory.IRequest.description: Filter, search, and pagination query for listing board categories (discussionboard_board_categories). Fields correspond to business search use cases as described in business requirements and search/discovery features.

IPageDiscussionboardBoardCategory.description:
Container type representing a page of board categories (IPageDiscussionboardBoardCategory). Used in listing/search endpoints, always contains both pagination metadata and the array of matching record entities.

References: IPage structure, listing/pagination patterns, and business requirements for scalable discovery interfaces.

IDiscussionboardBoardCategory.description:
Board categorization entity from Prisma discussionboard_board_categories. Groups boards for search, analytics, and administration, allowing bulk navigation/filtering by business case and taxonomic structure.

All fields from database model are present and documented.

IDiscussionboardBoardCategory.ICreate.description: Request data for creating a board category (IDiscussionboardBoardCategory.ICreate). Maps to the input business/admin logic for new category creation; all properties map to field normalization rules. All required fields are present.

IDiscussionboardBoardCategory.IUpdate.description: Update/patch for a board category entity (IDiscussionboardBoardCategory.IUpdate). Both properties optional, allowing partial update logic in admin interfaces.

IDeleteResult.description: Standard container for confirming the deletion of an entity by id. Used by delete endpoints to report success and audit context; maps to audit/retention policy requirements across platform.

IDiscussionboardBoardFeature.IRequest.description: Request type for searching, filtering, and paginating board feature assignments (discussionboard_board_features). Used by list endpoints for config, analytics, management/UX.

IPageDiscussionboardBoardFeature.description: Container for paginated board feature assignment records (IPageDiscussionboardBoardFeature). Used in admin UI and config dashboards for scalable board feature management and analytics.

IDiscussionboardBoardFeature.description: Atomic assignment of a feature to a board entity (discussionboard_board_features). Used in admin configuration, feature rollout, and analytics; all fields are documented and mapped to business/config requirements.

IPageDiscussionboardPostEditHistory.description:
A paginated result set of discussion board post edit history records.

This type is used when listing or searching the full audit trail for post edits, as defined by the 'discussionboard_post_edit_histories' Prisma schema. It includes pagination details and an array of individual edit events. Each record represents a single atomic edit of a post, created by members, moderators, or admins as per the strict auditing and compliance requirements of the discussion board system. This schema enables UIs and audit tools to efficiently page through high-volume edit histories while retaining full context for each change.

IDiscussionboardPostEditHistory.description:
A full atomic record of a post edit event in the discussion board.

This type represents a normalized history entry for an edit to a post, as recorded in the discussionboard_post_edit_histories table. It aligns with requirements for strict compliance, auditability, and transparency by capturing all relevant details: which post was edited, who made the edit, what the previous values were, and the reason for the edit. Used for displaying edit history UIs, supporting moderation and dispute resolution workflows, and enabling compliant rollback/forensics on post content modifications.

IDiscussionboardPostEditHistory.ICreate.description:
The payload for creating a new post edit history entry. Matches the structure and compliance requirements of the 'discussionboard_post_edit_histories' Prisma model.

All required audit properties must be present, and nullable fields are for unchanged or unavailable prior values. This schema enables compliance with the platform's strict audit and transparency mandates.

IDiscussionboardPostEditHistory.IUpdate.description:
Payload for updating (patching) an existing post edit history record for audit correction or administrative revision.

Optional fields may be supplied to amend an event; only supplied properties are updated. Strict audit logging and policy apply to modification of history entries.

IPage.IPagination.description:
Page information for paginated result sets in the discussion board API.

This structure provides all required metadata to page through large datasets, such as edit histories or user activity logs. It enables robust navigation, audit, and compliance workflows per the business and technical requirements. Derived from the standard IPage pattern as adopted throughout the API.

IDiscussionboardPostLike.IRequest.description:
Request contract for searching, filtering, and paging post like records from the discussionboard_post_likes table.

Includes criteria for filtering by post, member, creation time, and standard pagination. Enables moderation, analytics, and user engagement reporting as per audit and discovery requirements.

IPageDiscussionboardPostLike.description:
Paginated response type for listing or searching post like records in the discussion board API.

Includes pagination controls and a list of like event objects. Used by moderation and user engagement reporting workflows, per requirements mapped to the discussionboard_post_likes DBA schema.

Idiscussionboard_postLikes.description:
Atomic representation of a single post like record in the discussion board system.

Matches one (member, post) pair with the corresponding timestamp. Enforces denormalized like-per-user rules from the requirements documentation and the Prisma post like schema.

Idiscussionboard_postLikes.ICreate.description:
Payload for creation of a new post like record in the discussion board API.

Mandates post and member cross-reference as per database integrity and business rule documentation. Used in user interaction, engagement analytics, and content popularity calculation.

Idiscussionboard_postLikes.IUpdate.description:
Payload for updating (patch/correcting) a post like record in the discussionboard_post_likes table.

Only 'created_at' may be adjusted; all ID and relational fields are immutable for referential/audit integrity. Used for administrative fixes or migration corrections, as described in compliance and operational requirements.

Idiscussionboard_postDislikes.IRequest.description:
Search, filter, and paging contract for querying post dislike records from the discussionboard_post_dislikes table.

Supports various analytics, moderation, and member profile use cases in the business logic.

IPageIdiscussionboard_postDislikes.description:
Paginated response object for lists of post dislike records from the discussion board.

Includes pagination info and the array of dislike actions, supporting UI views, moderation analytics, and audit workflows per the requirements and Prisma schema.

Idiscussionboard_postDislikes.description:
Normalized, atomic representation of a dislike event from the discussionboard_post_dislikes table.

Each record denotes a single member's negative response to a post and is crucial for analytics, policy enforcement, and engagement features described in the requirements and business logic.

IDiscussionboardBan.description:
Discussion board ban entity representing a punitive measure against a member, as implemented in the moderation domain and fulfilling compliance, audit trail, and user sanction requirements.

This schema maps directly to the discussionboard_bans table in Prisma and is referenced in the requirements for ban management, audit logging, moderation actions, and appeals. A ban record is generated whenever a member is banned (temporarily or permanently), either by moderator or system action. It tracks duration, type, rationale, moderation linkage, and the affected member.

Paragraph 2: Ban records are crucial for transparency, legal audit, and compliance with platform policy enforcement. This type is involved in nearly all disciplinary, sanction, and appeal workflows.

IDiscussionboardBan.ICreate.description:
Request body for creating a new ban record in the moderation domain. Implements moderation compliance, requiring all atomic ban data for the ban creation workflow, as per discussionboard_bans schema.

This type is used when moderators or admins initiate a ban action, supplying all details required for audit traceability (member, action link, type, duration, rationale).

It is referenced by the API documentation and business requirements for system-wide ban creation and admin workflows.

IDiscussionboardBan.IUpdate.description:
Payload for updating an existing discussionboard_bans record. Designed for admin or moderator use in workflows such as appeal reviews, error corrections, or compliance updates.

Updates may be allowed for expiry date/time, reason, or correction of mistake by authorized parties. All modifications are audited by the platform.

Relevant for compliance and reversal cases.

IDiscussionboardWarning.IRequest.description:
Request type for listing, filtering, or searching warning records (discussionboard_warnings). Implements audit, analytics, and moderation reporting per platform requirements. Used as input for PATCH endpoints listing warnings.

Allows fine-grained reporting by member, type, issue time, or action linkage.

For platform admins, moderators, or auditors.

IPageIDiscussionboardWarning.description:
Paginated results container for warning entity listing (discussionboard_warnings) in compliance with the IPage<T> pattern.

Implements platform-wide standard for paginated API responses (page info and result list).

Used by admin and moderator dashboards, reporting, and audit tools. See Samchon IPage standard for core structure and business context.

IDiscussionboardWarning.description:
Canonical warning event record as per discussionboard_warnings in Prisma schema. Used for audit, moderation, notification, and appeal workflows. Warnings may be informal or formal, and are linked directly to moderation actions.

Detailed enough to support reporting, analytics, compliance, and user notification features.

Directly related to member status and repeated infraction logic.

IDiscussionboardWarning.ICreate.description:
Request body for creating a warning (discussionboard_warnings). Used by moderators/admins when recording a user warning event after policy violation in the moderation workflow.

Must provide atomic info for connection with member, action, type, reason, and issuance time.

Fulfills platform requirements for compliance and notification logging.

discussionboard_warnings.IUpdate.description:
Schema for updating a discussionboard_warnings record, as used in PATCH/PUT moderator/admin API operations. Useful for appeal processes, error correction, or admin edits to rationale.

Only warning_type, warning_message are commonly mutable; member and moderation_action_id are typically not changed post-creation for trace/audit consistency.

Detailed for compliance and reporting workflows.

discussionboard_warnings.description:
Warning entity type as per discussionboard_warnings table. This may overlap with IDiscussionboardWarning but is directly used as data row in Prisma, for platform reporting, history review, and compliance operations.

All event, member, action, type codes, timestamps, and rationales must be atomic (per platform 3NF policy). Used in moderation dashboards, reporting, analytics, and appeal systems.

Descriptive for internal reporting and cross-linking between historical compliance objects.

discussionboard_appeals.IRequest.description:
Filtering, searching, or pagination criteria for discussionboard_appeals table, as used in appeals reporting, review, dashboard, and search. Powers admin, moderator, member appeal status review workflows with permission filtering.

Referenced for admin, staff, or member requests of the system appeals API endpoints.

Allows review by status, type, appellant, moderator/admin reviewer, creation timestamps, and supporting audit attributes.

IPageDiscussionboardAppeals.description:
Page result container for discussionboard_appeals table search/listing. Used for admin, moderator, staff, or user-facing dashboards or audit trails.

Implements Samchon standard IPage<T> structure for pagination info and results.

Necessary for high-scale review of user appeals across time, type, or policy.

Merges IPage pattern with appeal entity summary according to requirements.

discussionboard_appeals.description:
Appeal record as stored in discussionboard_appeals. Canonical entity for member-initiated dispute of moderation actions including ban, warning, or content removal. Central to dispute, audit, transparency, and governance features per requirements.

Atomic for audit: all identifiers, status, and timestamps individually tracked.

Used for reporting, moderation dashboards, staff workflows, member self-service audit, and regulatory export. Linked to moderation actions, staff/admin users, and member submitter by foreign keys.

Implements appeal lifecycle mechanics and compliance logic in platform.

IPage.IPagination.description:
Page information.

Contains details about the pagination state of a result set: current page, limit per page, total records, and total pages.
Based on the Samchon IPage standard used throughout the platform.

IDiscussionboardPostAttachment.IUpdate.description:
Update object for modifying metadata of a post attachment record.

Reference: discussionboard_post_attachments Prisma table. Used in edit attachment/migration workflows. Editable properties include file_uri (string, uri), file_name (string), and mime_type (string).

IDiscussionboardPostTag.IRequest.description:
Request filter and pagination object for listing or searching post-tag assignments in discussionboard_post_tags.

Includes direct filters by post_id, tag_id, creation dates, and standard paging (page, limit). Reference: discussionboard_post_tags schema. Used in admin, analytics, and discovery UIs.

IPageIDiscussionboardPostTag.description:
Container for a paginated set of post-tag assignment summaries, with pagination info.

References IPage<T> pattern and IDiscussionboardPostTag.ISummary for each assignment.

Used in: tag search, admin UI, analytics. Built atop discussionboard_post_tags schema.

IDiscussionboardPostTag.description:
A normalized record showing the association between a post and a board tag.

Each object represents the tagging of a post with a single tag, including metainformation about assignment ID, post reference, tag reference, and creation time.

Source: discussionboard_post_tags Prisma table.

IDiscussionboardPostTag.ICreate.description:
